newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico says first half air passengers up 9.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Mexico says first half air passengers up 9.3 pct.

text.p: An improved economy helped boost traffic in Mexico's airports by 9.3 percent in the first six months of 1997 from the year-ago period, Communication and Transportation Minister Carlos Ruiz Sacristan said on Monday.
He said in a statement that the increase follows a rise internationally in airline traffic.
Mexico is preparing to privatise its airports that are profitable, or 35 of the 58 sites, in regional packages.
Sacristan said on Monday the ministry is putting the final touches on the long-delayed privatisation scheme. A plan is expected to be announced later this month.
